warp.bot: Use this to draft or schedule an Instagram, X, Facebook, or LinkedIn post. Prefer exportId (Studio export UUID) or elementVariationId when posting Studio/element stills — JoAi copies those images onto the post and leaves the originals alone. Otherwise upload with media_upload and pass IDs in media. Do not combine media with exportId or elementVariationId. For Instagram, set format to feed (default), short (one MP4 → Reel), or story (one JPEG or MP4). Set scheduledAt in the team timezone when the user names a time - that only queues the post; JoAi's publish job posts to the network later. Omit scheduledAt to keep a draft. Platforms: instagram, x, facebook, linkedin. The response includes shareUrl — a public preview link (caption, media, network, time) you can give the user for review before publish.

description.en: Network to post on
description.de: Netzwerk für den Post

description.en: Post caption or tweet text
description.de: Bildunterschrift oder Tweet-Text

inputs.name: Format

description.en: Instagram only: feed (default), short (one MP4 Reel), or story (one JPEG or MP4).
description.de: Nur Instagram: feed (Standard), short (ein MP4-Reel) oder story (ein JPEG oder MP4).

inputs.bot: Instagram only. feed | short | story. Defaults to feed. short requires one MP4; story requires one JPEG or MP4.

inputs.name: Media

description.en: Ordered team media IDs, e.g. ["abc","def"]. Instagram feed: JPEG 1–10 or one MP4; short: one MP4; story: one JPEG or MP4. X: JPEG/PNG/WEBP/GIF 0–4. Facebook: JPEG/PNG/WEBP/GIF 0–10. LinkedIn: JPEG/PNG/GIF 0–9. Upload with media_upload first. Do not combine with exportId or elementVariationId.
description.de: Team-Medien-IDs in Reihenfolge, z.B. ["abc","def"]. Instagram Feed: JPEG 1–10 oder ein MP4; Short: ein MP4; Story: ein JPEG oder MP4. X: JPEG/PNG/WEBP/GIF 0–4. Facebook: JPEG/PNG/WEBP/GIF 0–10. LinkedIn: JPEG/PNG/GIF 0–9. Zuerst mit media_upload hochladen. Nicht zusammen mit exportId oder elementVariationId.

inputs.bot: JSON array of media IDs from media_upload, in order. Optional for X, Facebook, and LinkedIn text-only posts. Mutually exclusive with exportId and elementVariationId. JoAi copies media onto the post.
